in_marathi.name: Hemavarnini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemavarnini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who has a golden body and splendid beauty. In Hindu mythology, Hemavarnini is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
